tools.name: build_docx
tools.description: Analytical report .docx from JSON or Markdown: title page, TOC field, headings, lists, tables with captions/sources, NATIVE Word charts (DrawingML + embedded xlsx), key figures, call-outs, scorecard, real footnotes (GOST R 7.0.100 style) or numeric refs, bibliography; default Times New Roman; 'gost' preset. Inserts the plain-language glossary automatically (slide 2 / section before the first heading) with only the metrics the document shows; meta.glossary=false switches it off.

tools.name: glossary
tools.description: Plain-language 'What the numbers mean' glossary. Detects which metrics a deck or report shows (TAM, SAM, SOM, CAGR, LTV, CAC, LTV/CAC, payback, gross margin, churn, NRR, Rule of 40, NPV, IRR, MOIC, pre/post-money, ROI, TCO and more; config/glossary.json, six locales) and builds the glossary slide(s) and report section. build_pptx and build_docx call it automatically; qa_check fails a document whose glossary is missing or incomplete.
tools.import: from glossary import detect, entries, slide_specs

output_schema.description: list: [{id, term, text}]; detect: metric ids in glossary order

tools.name: qa_check
tools.description: QA for deck + report: text overflow, off-slide shapes, fonts < 10 pt, label titles, missing sources on data slides/tables/charts, charts as images, missing workbooks, density, placeholders, dummy text, hype phrases, notes; cross-document consistency of key facts. Exit code 1 on errors. Completeness gate (default on): errors when market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM), CAGR or unit economics is missing, when a customer pattern lacks ROI/payback, when gap placeholders ("no data", "TBD", "нет данных", "数据缺口"…) appear, or when a pattern's mandatory terms are absent. Flags --pattern, --no-completeness. Glossary gate: errors when the 'What the numbers mean' slide/section is missing or does not explain a metric shown (--no-glossary to skip).
cli: python qa_check.py --pptx deck.pptx --docx report.docx --facts facts.json [--locale en] [--out qa.json]
tools.import: from qa_check import run_qa

tools.name: research_ledger
tools.description: Evidence ledger for every number: a sourced fact needs a link; an estimate needs a method/formula, a low–base–high range and a confidence. Validates, deduplicates, normalises currency (meta.fx) and price year (meta.inflation), resolves conflicts (sourced > confidence > official source > newer; conflict flag when spread > 10%), exports flattened values, a ledger table and citation records.
tools.import: from research_ledger import new_ledger, add_fact, validate, resolve, export

key.description: ledger key, e.g. count.smb_G, industry.growth, wage.monthly

tools.output: export: {validation:{ok, errors, warnings}, values:{key_with_underscores: value}, conflicts, sources, table, warnings, stats:{sourced, estimates}}

tools.name: estimator

Every result can be written to the ledger as an estimate.

tools.name: auto_pitch
tools.description: Autonomous mode, one command: brief → profile → market definition → research plan (stop with --plan-only so the agent can research) → ledger + estimates → TAM/SAM/SOM (3 methods), CAGR, price, unit economics, customer ROI/TCO, financial model, NPV/IRR/MOIC, Rule of 40, valuation → pitch pattern (explicit or auto from audience) → deck(s) + report → QA. Never stops at missing data; logs every estimate in ledger_full.json and lists only a short to-confirm set.
cli: python auto_pitch.py --brief brief.json [--pattern large_investor|small_investor|corporate|smb|government|auto] [--theme comet --theme warm] [--locale ru] [--out DIR] [--render]
